annotation.title_clean: MESA INTERMINISTERIAL SOBRE INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL - Decisión Administrativa 750/2023
annotation.title_en: Inter-Ministerial Roundtable on Artificial Intelligence - Administrative Decision 750/2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros, Argentina
annotation.venue: Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina
annotation.summary_en: Argentine Administrative Decision 750/2023 creates an Inter-Ministerial Roundtable on Artificial Intelligence under the Cabinet Chief's Office, coordinated with the Secretariat of Strategic Affairs, to design a comprehensive national AI strategy within an ethical, sustainable and digital-transformation framework.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Mesa Interministerial sobre IA under the Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros
Mandate: design a comprehensive AI strategy for the national Executive within an ethical, sustainable framework
Members: Cabinet Chief's Office and ministries of Science, Defense, Economy, Foreign Affairs, Health, Security, Labour, plus Strategic Affairs Secretariat
Coordinators may invite other public and private entities
